meta.edition: base game, classic A-X distribution (no expansions)
meta.startTileNote: One of the 4 type-D tiles is the start tile (darker back). It is placed face-up before play; the remaining 71 are drawn.

conventions.edges: Each tile is described in a fixed canonical (unrotated) orientation. Edges are N(top), E(right), S(bottom), W(left).
conventions.rotation: Rotating a tile 90 deg clockwise maps N->E->S->W->N. Rotate both the 'edges' map and every edge reference inside 'features' the same way.
conventions.placementRule: A tile may be placed in an empty cell iff every edge it shares with an already-placed neighbor has the same edgeType (city-city, road-road, field-field).
conventions.featureConnectivity: Each entry in 'features' is ONE connected feature. Edges listed together belong to the same feature and connect through the tile. Separate features (e.g. two cities that do not touch) are listed as separate entries. A road feature listing a single edge is a road end (dead-ends into a cloister, a junction, or a city gate).
conventions.pennant: Cities only. true = the city segment shows a pennant/shield (counts as an extra 2 points when the city is completed).
conventions.fields: Field/farmer modeling is intentionally OMITTED here. Correct farm scoring needs a finer half-edge model (a road splits the field along an edge into two sides, and each field must record which completed cities it borders). See meta.fieldsTODO.
